correctness.rationale: The theorem fully specifies H on the torus, stationary Haar measure, Delta_n and all frequency quantifiers. Conditional Haar transformations prove uniform Delta_1 and Delta_2. Exhaustive exact rational half-integer clipping yields 320 non-overlapping positive-area third-iterate branch cells of unit total area; Green-integral edge grouping has precisely the displayed twelve rational coefficients and zero lower-order terms, independently replayed using the actual check.py path. Fourier uniqueness gives the whole positive continuous piecewise-linear density. Exact rational extrema and a full algebraic check in Q(sqrt5) of all residues mod 60 prove the sharp zero set and minimal multiplier. No finite-frequency experiment is substituted for the infinite claim.

value.rationale: The three-step horizontal displacement is the first non-Haar single-time transport law of a canonical two-tent area-preserving mixing map. The exact 12-knot density, positivity range and residue-60 minimal integer uniformization distinguish transient transport from both qualitative mixing and periodic-orbit descriptions, supplying an interpretable, reusable finite-horizon benchmark for dynamics near a parabolic mixing boundary. The problem is motivated by short-time stirring and tests a natural complete observable, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
